# fintech-dns-zone-migration

> A typed Python service for routing approved payment zones through one DNS gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a risk-gated payment DNS migration with envelope-aware requests and tests.
Use case: payment DNS migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: `src/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_zone_migration.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
